bottega.p1: In Renaissance Florence a bottega was a master's workshop: specialist artisans under one roof, making commissioned work to measure for each client. Verrocchio's bottega trained Leonardo.
bottega.p2: The Agentcy runs the same way. Seven specialist agents share one workshop and your Brand DNA, keep your marketing moving every day, and nothing leaves the workshop without your approval. Su misura: made to measure, never from a template.

sarto.line: Reads your brand and cuts the month's plan to measure. That is Puntino, and he wears the tape.

stratega.line: Studies the market, the competitors and the moment, then picks the angle.

pittore.line: Images, carousels, flyers and storyboards, in your palette every time.

tenore.line: Voiceovers, podcasts and the voice of your videos.

scrittore.line: Copy, captions, newsletters and articles, typed in your tone.

sommelier.line: Tastes every piece against your Brand DNA before it leaves the workshop.

postino.line: Schedules and delivers to every channel. On a Vespa, naturally.

bottega.beadBody: Every maestro carries a Murano glass bead. In the studio it is a status light, so you know what the workshop is doing before you read a word.
